periods.label: Leader of the Hounds bandit group

status.condition: captured after Lux disables his EX Wyvern

periods.summary: Unnamed leader of the Hounds bandit group. He tries to abduct Ariel by using a hostage and Abysses, but the reunited New Kingdom elite annihilate his force and Lux defeats him without killing him.

lux-arcadia.summary: Attempts to flee through Lux and is instantly disabled.

airi-arcadia.summary: Airi identifies him by Dragon Voice and explains his defeat.

key_events.summary: Leads the Hounds attack but is captured after his EX Drag-Ride is destroyed by Lux and his body is bound by Teifa.
